sites.name: Carrowmore Megalithic Cemetery
sites.era: ancient (era not stated on the pages read)
sites.what: Described by the OPW as Ireland's oldest megalithic tombs.

access.opening: 12 March to 2 December 2026; winter hours 5 November to 2 December, open 09:00, last admission 16:00.
access.tickets: Adult €5 (about A$7.95 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), child or student €3, family €13.
access.permits: No permit stated; entry by ticket.
